notes.text: BUG: Trainer dashboard shows 0 clients, but database has 4 clients correctly linked to org. Data discrepancy between super admin view and trainer view. Likely app query or RLS issue.
Email and phone system setup needed
Change super admin login credentials (email & password) before launch
Dashboard shows 'Total Users' instead of 'Total Trainers'. Count shows 0 but clicking reveals 4 users. Fix label + count.
Remove 'Active Today' and 'Weekly Completions' cards from super admin dashboard - not relevant

Super Admin should NOT create programs or have clients. Role is to: manage trainers, view all trainer data (programs, clients) for support, and optionally assign programs to clients on behalf of trainers. Trainers are the ones who create programs and coach clients.
